# EL8 coreutils defaults

These five unchanged configuration defaults were extracted from the Red Hat UBI
`coreutils-common-8.30-21.el8_10.x86_64` RPM in a disposable UBI 8 container.
They are public distribution defaults, not files from the target server.

The replacement RPM preserves their paths with `%config(noreplace)`. Original
copyright notices are retained. Sources are pinned individually in
`sources.lock.json` and included in the corresponding SRPM.
